|game_text=Unless [[Imperial Atrocity (V){{!}}Imperial Atrocity]] on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. |errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are its two release-sheet slips (the second is printed mirrored, like the Decipher card). The later errata version is [[Hindsight (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF dated 19 December 2011, the same file the Players Committee site offered in February 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless Imperial Atrocity on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played Interrupt here.” The release-sheet slips ([[:File:VB7-p4-146-Hindsight.png]], and the mirrored copy [[:File:VB7-p4-148-Hindsight.png]] for the backwards Decipher card) print it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Hindsight (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013; the ▲ written out as “take into hand any one card from reserve deck; reshuffle”) has “reduce loss by 6” instead of 4<ref name="cl-1274_18-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “Unless Imperial Atrocity on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 6 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played Interrupt here.” Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-10; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> print the same text (AR 2.0 writes the Control mark as “Immune to Control.”). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-hindsight-pre.gif]]) prints it. The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 11 April 2012 as a Competitive Balance Team errata, legal from 20 April 2012<ref name="pcforum-p710277">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 11 April 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p710277 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
